ausgabefähigen Default. Fünf Ganzwortkerne wechseln von `Dosis/Dosen` zu
`Portion/Portionen`; 13 Positionswerte und dadurch neun der 51 Leserzeilen
ändern sich. 479 Positionen werden weiterhin genau einmal in 471 sichtbaren
Einheiten verbraucht. Scores, Scopes und Komponentenexport bleiben unverändert.

peer_checks.reason: The old Dosen and hiervon fields are explicitly distinct from the V99 Portion core and BOS-detach decision. The portable core contains portion/medium-dried/drug/measure content; no unsupported predecessor is imported.

The static row correctly makes `vollständig erhitzte und abgeschlossene Portion` portable and reserves `Zubereitung` for the context aggregate. Do not describe Zubereitung as portable core or collapse the older Dosis rival.
The two positions support repeated source scope within this proposal, not two independent meaning confirmations. Retain three parts/drying-in-three-parts as rivals and historical unit uncertainty.
The static row and OB card correctly remove unsupported hiervon while preserving Portion, second dry-preparation and unresolved ordinal/material binding.

No exact dcheey card was found in the bounded priorities search. Distinct dchey cards cannot substitute for this exact form. Preserve patient/unit/historical-use uncertainty and do not infer dcheey=dchey.

overall: OB correctly recovers all five changed V99 core propositions. OD’s earlier “only dcheey gap” was too narrow: each old Dosen/Dosis or hiervon form differs from the later Portion/BOS-detached proposition even when an older same-form card exists. These remain unconfirmed historical scope variants, not five independent discoveries.
